subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Mental maths (number range 15)
source.subtopic: Rapid recall of number bonds; practise addition and subtraction facts to 5

show.line: Quick sums! Two plus three? Five! Five minus one? Four! Know them fast, no counting.

rounds.prompt: Quick! Three plus two. Say the answer.
Quick! One plus one. Say the answer.
Does the answer make five or four? Sort the sums.

hints: Picture your fingers. You know this one!
Think of the bond. Two and three make five.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Quick! Five minus three.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five minus three equals two.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's check with fingers. Five, fold three down. Two left!

parent_line: Knows the adding and taking away facts to 5 quickly.
